response.sql:
SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) AS total_triple
FROM batting_postseason
WHERE league_id = 'NL' OR round = 'WS'
GROUP BY player_id
ORDER BY total_triple DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “NL and World Series postseason batting records” means records in the NL or in the World Series (round = 'WS'); totals include all postseason batting records for players meeting that condition.
